name: RW04-B6 Windows revenue reconciler
description: RW04-B6 (RW04 real-world test). Brings the order, stock, CRM and shipment rows together for the 10 orders, compares line counts, tax, currency, shipment and status, finds duplicates and missing rows, keys each bundle into the demo order-entry desktop app (the legacy revenue system, with its validation pop-up handled by an interrupt rule), writes the exception sheet, recalculates the workbook in Excel, stores it in SharePoint, reads it back and checks the totals.

variables.name: status

variables.name: result_file
variables.description: CSV file with one row per record.

args.text: What this agent does: Brings the order, stock, CRM and shipment rows together for the 10 orders, compares line counts, tax, currency, shipment and status, finds duplicates and missing rows, keys each bundle into the demo order-entry desktop app (the legacy revenue system, with its validation pop-up handled by an interrupt rule), writes the exception sheet, recalculates the workbook in Excel, stores it in SharePoint, reads it back and checks the totals. It works through 10 order bundles and writes its results to the run's output folder.
